subject: Subprocessor decommissioning notice — request for Article 28/30 evidence and handover
messages:
From: Maria Gonzalez <maria.gonzalez@databank.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Cc: irene_choi@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 9 Jul 2028 14:08:00 +0000
Subject: Notice: third-party analytics subprocessor being decommissioned (impact & evidence request)

Hi Vanessa,

Following our vendor review, we wanted to notify you that DataStream Analytics (a third-party subprocessor we use for short-term session tracing) will be decommissioned on 2028-08-01. This will affect traces stored for diagnostic sessions older than 30 days.

As part of our incoming audit, the compliance team has asked for: 
- A short confirmation that Redwood will no longer rely on DataStream for processing after 2028-08-01.
- An extract of your Art. 30 register rows that reference DataStream (including processing purposes and lawful basis).
- Evidence of secure data handover or deletion (retention logs, export manifest).

Could you provide the above by EOD 2028-07-13? We also included our auditor (forensic-audit.io) on this thread for transparency.

Best,
Maria Gonzalez
Head of Privacy Operations
DataBank Ltd.
[Attachment: vendor_notice_from_datastream.pdf (PDF, 78KB)]

From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
To: Maria Gonzalez <maria.gonzalez@databank.com>
Cc: irene_choi@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 9 Jul 2028 16:22:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Notice: third-party analytics subprocessor being decommissioned (impact & evidence request)

Hi Maria — thanks for the heads up. We're starting a short intake to cover the items you listed. Quick notes: 

- We will confirm operational decommissioning and that no live inference or customer telemetry will route to DataStream after 2028-08-01.
- We can provide an Art. 30 extract and an export manifest (CSV) showing processed categories and data flow entries.
- For deletion proof, we have retention/deletion job logs and an S3 export snapshot we can surface to auditors.

Irene and Ben — can you take point on producing: (1) Art. 30 extract, (2) deletion/retention logs, and (3) a short handover checklist we can send to DataBank? I’ll coordinate with Legal if any contract language needs an amendment.

Targeting initial package by 2028-07-12 EOD. If we need more time, we’ll flag it early.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Enterprise Compliance
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: subprocessor_decom_notice.pdf (PDF, 42KB)]

From: irene_choi@redwood.ai
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, Maria Gonzalez <maria.gonzalez@databank.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 10 Jul 2028 09:03:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Notice: third-party analytics subprocessor being decommissioned (impact & evidence request)

Thanks Vanessa — taking this on. Practical steps and what I’ll include in the package: 

1) Art. 30 extract: CSV with rows for DataStream showing legal basis, categories of data (session ids, ip hash, debug traces), subprocessors chain, and subprocessing purpose.
2) Art. 28 addendum excerpt: copy of the clause referencing subprocessor termination and transitional controls.
3) Deletion evidence: retention job logs (timestamped), a transfer/export manifest for data handed to DataBank for continuity, and a final purge job run ID.
4) Handover checklist: confirmation of no open incidents, list of active customers using DataStream (if any), and timeline for tracing cutover.

Ben — could you pull the export manifest and the purge job logs (job IDs + timestamps)? I’ll assemble the Art. 30 CSV and the checklist.

Irene Choi
Senior Privacy Engineer
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: art30-register-extract.csv (CSV, 12KB)]

From: ben_carter@redwood.ai

Hi all — pulled the export and purge artifacts. Attached: handover-checklist.docx with the manifest table and purge job references. Quick summary below, for auditors: 

- Export manifest: s3://redwood-exports/datastream/2028-07-11/export-manifest.json (manifest lists 13 files, MD5 checksums included)
- Purge job: job_id=purge-20280711-08, started 2028-07-11T08:03:04Z, completed 2028-07-11T08:17:30Z, rows removed: 38,234 (session traces older than 30 days).
- No active customer routes to DataStream after 2028-07-11 09:00Z (we completed routing cutover).

Marissa — Legal asked whether we want DataBank to sign a short attestation acknowledging receipt of the exported traces and confirming the handover timeline. If so, I can add a DocuSign placeholder.

Attaching the checklist and manifest stubs.

Ben Carter
